summary: Iteration 14 (Document/Data integration sprint) — Full backend + frontend verification. Backend: 25/25 new tests PASS in test_library_sprint.py covering GET /api/library/{documents,proposals,contracts,invoices} (shape/pagination/page_size cap 50/filters/sort), POST /api/documents/upload -> real object storage + appears in /api/library/documents, PUT rename, GET /file with ?auth=token AND Bearer AND unauth 401 AND 404-after-delete, DELETE, GET /api/analytics (real KPIs), GET /api/notifications, GET /api/dashboard/search now includes documents group, org isolation (fresh user sees 0 docs/proposals/contracts/invoices/$0 revenue). Demo org: /api/library/invoices returns count=1, status Generated, subtotal 7200 total 8640 outstanding 0 revenue 0 (correct because status is Generated not Paid/Sent). Invoice-status filter works server-side. Auth-less requests return 401 on all new endpoints. Frontend (real UI): Login demo -> Documents page loaded via GET /api/library/documents; upload via documents-file-input succeeded and file appears in grid; documents-search filters, doc-rename-<id>+doc-rename-input+doc-rename-save works; doc-delete-<id>+confirm-delete-doc removes. Proposals page (demo=0 real data, empty state visible). Contracts page shows 1 real contract with contracts-item-<id>. Invoices page: invoices-totals (Revenue/Outstanding/Total) reads real numbers ($0/$0/1 for demo since invoice=Generated), invoice-status-tabs work (invoice-tab-generated filters to 1 row), invoice-row-<id> visible with Open button. Analytics page: analytics-kpi-clients=3 projects=3 (real). Notifications dropdown opens with 10 real recent activities. Global search dashboard-search-input='SOW' returns Documents group (search-result-documents present) and clicking navigates to /documents. Deep-link /projects/:id?tab=invoice opens Project Workspace with Invoice tab active. Isolation E2E: freshly registered user sees documents-empty, invoices-empty (with $0/$0/0 totals), contracts-empty, proposals-empty, analytics kpis 0/0.
critical_code_review_comments: documents/upload: 25MB size cap enforced but no MIME-type whitelist — anything (including .exe) can be uploaded to object storage. Consider allow-list or a content-type sniff for defense-in-depth.

library_invoices totals only aggregates Paid+Sent+Overdue for revenue/outstanding. Draft/Generated/Cancelled/Archived correctly excluded — but consider surfacing 'Generated' subtotal in the UI header (currently the KPI card can look empty for a fresh business that has only generated but not sent).

download endpoint accepts ?auth=<token> in query string. Access tokens end up in server access logs and browser history. Consider signed short-lived download URLs (JWT with 60s expiry, scope=download:<docId>) instead of raw access token.
server.py is now 1823 lines — well past the 700-line soft ceiling in the review guidelines. Split into routers (documents.py, library.py, analytics.py, notifications.py) for maintainability.
